description: React context provider for managing flow nodes and edges in a React Flow diagram, including node duplication, deletion, and status updates.

classes.name: ReactFlowContext
classes.description: React context provider component for managing flow diagram state, including node and edge operations.

methods.name: onAgentflowNodeStatusUpdate
methods.description: Updates the status and error state of a specific node.

methods.name: clearAgentflowNodeStatus
methods.description: Clears the status and error information for all nodes.

methods.name: onNodeDataChange
methods.description: Handles updates to node input parameters and manages visibility of input parameters.

methods.name: deleteNode
methods.description: Deletes a node and all its descendant nodes and associated edges.

methods.name: deleteConnectedInput
methods.description: Removes input connections from nodes based on connected edges.

methods.name: duplicateNode
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of a specified node with a new ID and adjusted position.
